fresh_read_reference.note: Context only; real preflight saves fresh power and verifies fresh profile identities.

limits: No device execution or visual pass
Template requires fresh exact holder/start and fixed private state path
No TERM, guardian restart/stop, cfg/runtime/data changes
Original desktop_launch unchanged; one launch intent and one selected-icon dispatch intent
Unknown input outcome is never replayed
Every successful uitest refreshes temporary awake and reads it back
Restore uses same boot/holder and exact original power; does not depend on child/parent/guardian state
Active UI budget540s plus normal60s restoration; late restoration alone receives bounded emergency60s
Original command timeout error and partial streams are retained without retries
